summary: Add the client reads slo.list and slo.history (GET /v1/client/slo and /v1/client/slo/history) so the TUI, the phone and the web app show the objectives and budgets that st slo prints

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; both reads are computed from live windows, limits readings and the local history log.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Adds two read operations to st3.client.v0 with SloList, SloRow and SloHistory in the schema and generated Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients. Existing operations are unchanged; an older daemon answers the new routes with 404, which a client treats as unavailable.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build removes the routes; clients show the section as unavailable.
